method: fit_cameras_depth.py: sim depth rendered at the recorded arm pose is matched to real D415 depth. The table fixes height and tilt; the whole-arm outline (everything standing above the real table plane near the arm) fixes position along the table. Field of view 43.3 deg from the cameras' own intrinsics.
frame: MuJoCo world frame of sorting_env; apply as camera pos/quat (not yet applied to station_scene.py)

overhead.note: Six depth captures 2026-11-14 20:32-20:38 (rest plus five poses 13 cm above the table). Bowl centres land within about 20 px (of 640). Real camera 243622061421.

wrist.note: Sim name "wrist" is the FIXED close camera 243722064316. One depth capture (arm at rest); at the raised poses the arm is outside its depth range, so its position along the table is less certain than the overhead. Refit if the stand is bumped.

known_inconsistency: Bowl centres from three sources (teleop releases, the laptop agent's releases, current overhead image) agree within about 2 cm; the scene uses their mean.
